LESSON: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.3 Hadith on planting (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the lear
Topic 2.4: Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life
3. appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building

What this means
In this part you learn to read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life

What this means
In this part you learn to use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources in your own words. (skill: use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building.
3. Practise this skill: use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?
2. How should a Muslim use time wisely?
3. What activities may cause harm to people’s health?
4. How do you spend your pocket money?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building.
5. Be able to: use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
